x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
from haau3 import BatchOk, Haau3, calls

client = Haau3()  # reads HAAU3_API_KEY
results = client.batch(
    calls.code_system_lookup(system="http://loinc.org", code="2345-7", property="SHORTNAME"),
    calls.code_system_lookup(system="http://loinc.org", code="8867-4", property="SHORTNAME"),
    calls.list_insurance_plan_counties(state="DE"),
)
for result in results:
    print(result.status if isinstance(result, BatchOk) else result.error)

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import json

from haau3 import Haau3, fhir

client = Haau3()  # reads HAAU3_API_KEY
# records.json holds one patient's FHIR medication records, as a Bundle.
with open("records.json") as file:
    records: fhir.Bundle = json.load(file)
bundle = client.reconcile_medications(records)
print(len(bundle.get("entry", [])))
